attributes.name: Echo of Lost Divinity
attributes.powers:
When you encounter this card, you may reveal a card that has the Pharasma trait to automatically acquire this card.

Recharge this card to reduce all damage dealt by a bane to 1, or to 0 if you have the Divine skill.

Bury this card to explore your location. During this exploration, reduce damage dealt to you by banes to 1. After playing this card, you may bury a card that has the Pharasma trait to recharge this card instead of burying it.
